page.overview:
Who is Aikawa?

Aikawa is an editor of V Jump in real life. He has also appeared as a character in V Jump alongside a number of cosplay characters.

The video game character Sergeant Aikawa is named after him.

Aikawa took part in the The Third Charisma Duelist Determining Fight Tournament. He defeated Senjome in the first round, Dueluka in the second round and Duelua in the finals, winning the tournament.

Aikawa uses a "Machina Gadget", referred to as "Machina & Gadget" (マシンナーズガジェット), Deck.
